name: Generate Translation String File
prompt: Read the /root/Desktop/messages.json file. This file contains an object where each key is a message ID and the corresponding value is an object that may have fields such as title, body, button_text, and error_message. Extract the string values from all fields (that is, the text that users see), and then generate a new JSON file /root/Desktop/strings.json. The new file is flat: each key is written in the form “message ID.field name”, for example welcome.title, and the value is the original English string. Finally, sort the keys in the new file in alphabetical order.
